parameters.content:
## AI Station ticket reply

1. Run `ai n8n configure` and attach Header Auth `Authorization: Bearer <LLM_API_KEY>` from `projects/n8n.env` to LiteLLM Reply.
2. Call only `http://llm-gateway:4000/v1` from inside Compose. Never `:8888` or llama.cpp ports.
3. Canonical model: `Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M`.
4. Replace the sample ticket text in Set ticket. Do not commit customer mail credentials.

assignments.name: ticket
assignments.value: Subject: Printer offline\nThe office printer on floor 2 shows offline. I already restarted it. Need a short status update I can send to the requester.

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "model": "Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M", "messages": [ { "role": "system", "content": "Write a short, polite support reply in the same language as the ticket. Do not invent facts. End with one next step." }, { "role": "user", "content": {{ JSON.stringify($json.ticket) }} } ], "max_tokens": 256 }
